resolved_findings.body: The test only expects loading the entire policy on September18 to fail. Prior records already expire September17, so they cause this error even if a new HIGH exception is extended. A temporary policy mutation changing TASK-13013.7.29-OS-01 expiry to 2026-09-18 still passed the complete test_only_the_72_verified_records_are_added_and_expire_on_schedule function. Assert every new record expires_on equals date(2026,9,17), or test expiry with a policy containing only the new records. The current policy dates are correct; this is a demonstrated regression-test gap.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent added explicit created_on and expires_on assertions for every new record at line59; verified the valid policy passes and the same September18 extension mutation is now rejected.
resolved_findings.title: Check expiry of the new records independently of the old records

tests.expiry_negative_control: Initially demonstrated the gap; after the parent fix the normal policy passes and a new HIGH record extended to September18 raises AssertionError as required.

python_review.base_image_reason: hydra-core, lightning, pytorch-lightning, and nemo-toolkit are absent from all three retained supported backend image SBOMs and the base source-export SBOM. This does not cover optional extras installed after build or different deployed images.

findings.missing_prerequisites: A deployment actually installing the affected optional STT graph, successfully reaching RNNT initialization after initial standard Parakeet loading, and able to retrieve the attacker-selected model. These are not present/proven in retained base images.
findings.optional_source_finding: Static attacker-input chain exists through authenticated NeMo Parakeet RNNT streaming: client model identifier -> arbitrary Hugging Face model namespace -> restore_from -> archive model YAML -> from_config_dict -> hydra.utils.instantiate. This is stronger than a mere package match, but no installed/working optional deployment was established.

findings.advisory_metadata_note: GitHub advisory affected-version table shows legacy lightning <2022.6.15 while prose and upstream fix identify through2.6.5; this inconsistency is not used as an exclusion.
findings.affected_api: LightningModule.load_from_checkpoint -> _load_state, with checkpoint hyperparameters._instantiator selecting an imported callable
findings.missing_prerequisites: No repository-controlled path from attacker input to a Lightning checkpoint or its _instantiator was established. This scoped conclusion assumes integrity of the fixed model source/cache and excludes custom checkpoint workflows or modified deployment code.
findings.optional_source_finding: Optional diarization -> pyannote-audio4.0.7 -> lightning2.6.5. Pyannote Model.from_pretrained does call Klass.load_from_checkpoint, so the API is transitively used. The repository workflow supplies the fixed pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1 identifier; client input is the audio and speaker counts, not the checkpoint identifier/metadata. NeMo restore_from instead uses its connector and load_state_dict, not Lightning load_from_checkpoint.

findings.affected_api: NeMo model/checkpoint deserialization; NVIDIA Curator notes associate this CVE pair with ASRModel.from_pretrained and torch.load/pickle.load.
findings.missing_prerequisites: Vendor bulletin does not distinguish the precise vulnerable function for this CVE from the other February deserialization issues. The inspected restore helper omits weights_only; current locked torch2.13.0 defaults that call to weights_only=True. A specific reachable unsafe deserializer under this exact optional graph has not been established. Installed and functioning optional deployment evidence is also absent.
findings.optional_source_finding: Optional STT_All/STT_Parakeet graph contains NeMo2.0.0. Authenticated streaming can supply a model ID to from_pretrained; controlled local execution calls restore_from on an explicit .nemo artifact. Neither is an audio upload being interpreted directly as a model checkpoint.

findings.affected_api: Loading a malicious file through NeMo model/checkpoint deserialization; NVIDIA Curator notes associate this CVE pair with ASRModel.from_pretrained and torch.load/pickle.load.
findings.missing_prerequisites: Vendor bulletin does not identify the exact CVE-specific callable. The observed torch.load helper has no explicit unsafe override, and locked torch2.13.0 defaults to weights_only=True. The separate pickle.load path and exact prerequisite were not proven reachable.
